# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 13
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 13

---

*[The paradise vision. The Lord shows Peter the dwelling-place of the righteous.]*

1. And we went to a great garden, glorious and beautiful, which was full of fair trees and most sweet-smelling herbs.

2. And there was a great fragrance in it, and there were trees bearing fruit, and there were springs of water and rivers flowing through it.

3. And the fruits of the trees were most beautiful and sweet, and flowers of every kind were there; and the smell of the garden was surpassing.

4. And the light thereof was seven times brighter than the light of the sun.

5. And in it were those clothed in the garments of the angels of light, and their clothing was like the light, and they praised God with a great voice.

6. And I, Peter, asked him: "Lord, who are these?"

7. And he said to me: "These are your brothers, the righteous, who received the crown of martyrdom."

8. And I said to him: "Lord, and where are those who shed their blood for you?"

9. And he showed me a great place, full of beautiful fruit-bearing trees and of spices and trees of healing; the fruit of those trees was most fragrant and beautiful.

10. And the roots of those trees were in the spring of life, and they were rejoicing over them and praising God.

11. And I asked: "These also — what have they done?"

12. And he said: "These are they who gave all they had to the poor and who loved God and did not love the world, who feared not the torments of men."

13. And he showed me a high and glorious place, more shining than the sun, and I saw David with his harp in that place, praising God with a joyful voice.

---
*EMET note: The paradise garden uses imagery from the Song of Songs and Revelation 22 — fruit, fragrance, springs of living water. The "seven times brighter" (v.4) echoes Isaiah 30:26's eschatological intensification of light.*
